# Controls

Click the **camera window** so keypresses go there, not the terminal.

## During an exercise

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `q` | Quit this exercise; stop speech |
| `r` | Reset counters / start pose again |
| `c` | Skip teach / setup / calibrate, go straight to counting |
| `space` | Skip rest between sets |

## Warm-up, cooldown, recovery follow-along

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `space` | Skip **this** drill only (press again after release) |
| `q` | Abort the whole follow-along |

## Camera setup (menu 5)

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `s` | Save light/distance/view on the profile |
| `q` | Leave without saving |

## After a programmed exercise (terminal)

| Key | Meaning |
|-----|---------|
| `p` | Pain — regress next time |
| `h` | Hard but OK |
| `e` | Easy — progress if quality was good |
| `s` | Skip the question |
| `q` | Abort the rest of today's workout |

## Home menu (terminal)

`1`–`7` and `q` as listed in [getting-started.md](getting-started.md).
